abstract: Monitors offshore subsea noise mitigation and benthic protection ratings
system_message:
You are Environmental compliance unit (ECU). The Environmental compliance unit (ECU) monitors offshore subsea noise mitigation and benthic protection ratings for saturation diving intervention teams.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors offshore subsea noise mitigation and benthic protection ratings（ENV）
information_points.content:
ECU-ENV-6TN：According to hydrophone monitoring conducted within 500 meters of the subsea manifold, Caledonian Deepwater Diving Alliance registered a subsea acoustic mitigation score of 94 points for high-frequency hydraulic cavitation dampening.
ECU-ENV-GC6：Hydrophone monitoring within 500 meters of the subsea manifold established that Grampian Subsea Specialist Group attained a subsea acoustic mitigation score of 68 points assessing high-frequency hydraulic cavitation dampening.
ECU-ENV-9MS：Based on hydrophone monitoring within 500 meters of the subsea manifold, North Sea Hyperbaric Operations Consortium achieved a subsea acoustic mitigation score of 68 points evaluating high-frequency hydraulic cavitation dampening.

information_points.title: Benthic disturbance monitoring（HAB）
information_points.content:
ECU-HAB-V7H：For North Sea Hyperbaric Operations Consortium, water column measurements 10 meters upstream of the pipeline manifold during tooling touchdown showed a seabed sediment turbidity index of 15 NTU.
ECU-HAB-PRW：Measurements taken in the water column 10 meters upstream of the pipeline manifold during tooling touchdown recorded a seabed sediment turbidity index of 35 NTU for Caledonian Deepwater Diving Alliance.
ECU-HAB-5JK：Grampian Subsea Specialist Group recorded a seabed sediment turbidity index of 25 NTU in the water column 10 meters upstream of the pipeline manifold during tooling touchdown.
